reconciliation.description: This indicator represents opening cash and cash equivalents. Filed as '加：期初现金及现金等价物余额' in Gotion High-Tech Co., Ltd. 2024 Annual Report and mapped to CAS canonical field 'opening_cash_and_cash_equivalents'. The signed amount is preserved without rounding.
reconciliation.source_reference: Consolidated cash flow statement, PDF pp. 135-136, 2024 column

reconciliation.name: Closing cash and cash equivalents
reconciliation.source_field: 六、期末现金及现金等价物余额
reconciliation.description: This indicator represents closing cash and cash equivalents. Filed as '六、期末现金及现金等价物余额' in Gotion High-Tech Co., Ltd. 2024 Annual Report and mapped to CAS canonical field 'closing_cash_and_cash_equivalents'. The signed amount is preserved without rounding.
reconciliation.source_reference: Consolidated cash flow statement, PDF pp. 135-136, 2024 column

reconciliation.name: Other cash reconciliation items
reconciliation.description: This indicator represents other cash reconciliation items. The CAS line '其他（未单独列报）' was blank or not separately reported by Gotion for 2024; normalized to zero so the CAS field set remains complete.
reconciliation.source_reference: Consolidated cash flow statement, PDF pp. 135-136, 2024 column
